fields.content: Hello, how to order food?

你好！很高兴成为你的中文老师。今天你想练习什么？

• Pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Hěn gāoxìng chéngwéi nǐ de zhōngwén lǎoshī. Jīntiān nǐ xiǎng liànxí shénme?
• Meaning: Hello! I am glad to be your Chinese tutor. What would you like to practice today?

Key Vocabulary:
- 你好 (nǐ hǎo) = Hello
- 老师 (lǎoshī) = Tutor / Teacher
- 练习 (liànxí) = Practice

• Pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Hěn gāoxìng chéngwéi nǐ de zhōngwén lǎoshī. Jīntiān nǐ xiǎng liànxí shénme?
• Meaning: Hello! I am glad to be your Chinese tutor. What would you like to practice today?

Key Vocabulary:
- 你好 (nǐ hǎo) = Hello
- 老师 (lǎoshī) = Tutor / Teacher
- 练习 (liànxí) = Practice
